facts.fact: Meera lashes the broken Rope-Hut door bar with Jassi's goat-hair cord and wedges the door with her pack; they recover seven of the eleven dry sticks from the felled juniper's root plate, and four are lost downslope.
facts.why: needed because ch15 ends with all eleven sticks swept out and the outline requires seven for the storm night.

facts.fact: Meera's redbark supply uses a brass button as the token for each drop, and the courier carries its twin (matches F052/F060); Meera links it to Varun's new brass button.
facts.why: needed because it supplies the 'Varun is her middleman' deduction in the outline.

facts.fact: Rohan names the thing the regent's side would pay a lordship for as the queen's seal and confirms Meera has held it; he had told only Varun and the queen.
facts.why: needed because the evidence chain requires the seal as the hunters' target.

facts.fact: Rohan says he suspected Meera was the Salt Fox after her 'you deliver me' in ch14 but chose not to know; he stood at Varun's wedding.
facts.why: needed because it reconciles ch14's slip with his not knowing until ch16 and deepens the ten-year friendship.
